title: Sheaf condition for the raw abelian stage Kan-extension colimit
statement: Let $J$ be a small filtered category, $F:J\to\mathrm{Cat}$ a diagram of small categories, and $V$ a cocone with vertex $C$ [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit]. Let $P_j$ and $Q$ be precoverages on $F(j)$ and $C$. Every transition functor $F(a)$ and cocone functor $V_j$ is continuous for the generated topologies [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology]. Fix $i\in J$ and an abelian sheaf $G$ on $P_i$. Write $I=\mathrm{Under}(i)$, $A_t=F(t.hom)_sG$, and $H=V_{i,s}G$. For $b:t\to t'$ give a sheaf map $\theta_b:A_t\to F(b.right)^s A_{t'}$ whose composite with the unit $G\to F(t.hom)^s A_t$ equals the unit at $t'$ componentwise as objects of the arrow category of abelian groups. For $t\in I$ let $B_t$ be an abelian presheaf on $C$, with $\beta_t:A_t\to V_t^p B_t$ exhibiting $B_t$ as the left Kan extension of the underlying presheaf of $A_t$ along $V_t^{op}$. Here $V_t=V_{t.right}$, $V_t^p$ is presheaf restriction, and a left Kan extension means that composition with $\beta_t$ bijects maps $B_t\to T$ with maps $A_t\to V_t^p T$ for every abelian presheaf $T$. Let $B:I\to\mathrm{PSh}(C,\mathrm{Ab})$ have these objects and satisfy, for all $b:t\to t'$ and $X\in F(t.right)$, $\beta_t(X)B(b)(V_tX)=\theta_b(X)\beta_{t'}(F(b.right)X)$ as objects of $\mathrm{Arrow}(\mathrm{Ab})$.Assume also that the object and arrow cocones of $V$ are set colimits [def-weil-pbc-arrows-functor]. Every $P_j$ and $Q$ has singleton isomorphism covers, covering pullbacks, stability under finite composition and finite base change [def-weil-pbc-finite-precoverage]. Every covering presieve of $P_j$ has finitely many distinct arrows. Transitions preserve covering presieves and pullbacks along their covering arrows. The $Q$-covers are exactly images of stage covering presieves transported along object equalities, and each $V_j$ preserves covering pullbacks.Then the actual presheaf colimit $\mathrm{colim}\,B$ satisfies the sheaf condition for $Q$ and its generated Grothendieck topology. No assertion is made about maps to the canonical inverse image or equality of its sections.

proof.text: Forget abelian groups when checking sheafness, using the forgetful sheaf criterion. For every Q cover use hQ to write it as an equality-transported image of a finite stage cover. The map on uncurried covering arrows is surjective, so every Q cover has finitely many arrows. Reuse the existing private finite_map_cover from ColimitSiteRawSectionSheaf, exposed locally by import all, rather than reproving it.

proof.text: Construct the filtered stage sheaf diagram and its comparison isomorphism using colimit_site_raw_abelian_stage_restriction. For a stage cover S each diagram object satisfies the sheaf condition for S. Whiskering with the forgetful functor preserves this filtered presheaf colimit. The existing finite-presieve filtered-colimit theorem implies the underlying set colimit satisfies the condition for S. Transport that condition through the whiskered comparison isomorphism.

theorem colimit_site_raw_abelian_section_isSheaf
    (J : Type u) [SmallCategory J] [IsFiltered J] (F : J ⥤ Cat.{u, u})
    (P : ∀ j : J, Precoverage (F.obj j))
    [∀ j, (P j).HasIsos] [∀ j, (P j).IsStableUnderFiniteComposition]
    [∀ j, (P j).IsStableUnderFiniteBaseChange] [∀ j, (P j).HasPullbacks]
    (hfinite : ∀ (j : J) (X : F.obj j) (R : Presieve X), R ∈ P j X →
      Finite R.uncurry)
    (hcover : ∀ (j k : J) (a : j ⟶ k) (X : F.obj j) (R : Presieve X),
      R ∈ P j X → R.map (F.map a).toFunctor ∈ P k ((F.map a).toFunctor.obj X))
    (hpullback : ∀ (j k : J) (a : j ⟶ k) (X Y Z : F.obj j) (R : Presieve X),
      R ∈ P j X → ∀ (f : Y ⟶ X) (g : Z ⟶ X), R f →
        PreservesLimit (cospan f g) (F.map a).toFunctor)
    [∀ (j k : J) (a : j ⟶ k),
      (F.map a).toFunctor.IsContinuous (P j).toGrothendieck (P k).toGrothendieck]
    (V : Cocone F)
    (hobjects : IsColimit (Cat.objects.mapCocone V))
    (harrows : IsColimit (Cat.arrows.mapCocone V))
    (Q : Precoverage V.pt)
    [Q.HasIsos] [Q.IsStableUnderFiniteComposition]
    [Q.IsStableUnderFiniteBaseChange] [Q.HasPullbacks]
    (hQ : (∀ (Y : V.pt) (R : Presieve Y), R ∈ Q Y ↔
          ∃ (j : J) (X : F.obj j) (S : Presieve X) (h : (V.ι.app j).toFunctor.obj X = Y),
            S ∈ P j X ∧ h ▸ S.map (V.ι.app j).toFunctor = R))
    (hVpullback : (∀ (j : J) (X Y Z : F.obj j) (R : Presieve X), R ∈ P j X →
            ∀ (f : Y ⟶ X) (g : Z ⟶ X), R f →
              PreservesLimit (cospan f g) (V.ι.app j).toFunctor))
    [∀ j : J, (V.ι.app j).toFunctor.IsContinuous
      (P j).toGrothendieck Q.toGrothendieck]
    (i : J) (G : Sheaf (P i).toGrothendieck AddCommGrpCat.{u})
    (θ : ∀ (t t' : Under i) (b : t ⟶ t'),
                        (sheafPullback (F.map t.hom).toFunctor AddCommGrpCat.{u}
                          (P i).toGrothendieck (P t.right).toGrothendieck).obj G ⟶
                        ((F.map b.right).toFunctor.sheafPushforwardContinuous AddCommGrpCat.{u}
                          (P t.right).toGrothendieck (P t'.right).toGrothendieck).obj
                          ((sheafPullback (F.map t'.hom).toFunctor AddCommGrpCat.{u}
                            (P i).toGrothendieck (P t'.right).toGrothendieck).obj G))
    (hθ : ∀ (t t' : Under i) (b : t ⟶ t'),
      (∀ X : F.obj i,
                          Arrow.mk
                            (((sheafAdjunctionContinuous (F.map t.hom).toFunctor AddCommGrpCat.{u}
                              (P i).toGrothendieck (P t.right).toGrothendieck).unit.app
                                G).hom.app (op X) ≫
                              (θ t t' b).hom.app (op ((F.map t.hom).toFunctor.obj X))) =
                          Arrow.mk
                            (((sheafAdjunctionContinuous (F.map t'.hom).toFunctor AddCommGrpCat.{u}
                              (P i).toGrothendieck (P t'.right).toGrothendieck).unit.app
                                G).hom.app (op X))))
    (B : Under i ⥤ (V.ptᵒᵖ ⥤ AddCommGrpCat.{u}))
    (β : ∀ t : Under i,
      ((sheafPullback (F.map t.hom).toFunctor AddCommGrpCat.{u}
        (P i).toGrothendieck (P t.right).toGrothendieck).obj G).obj ⟶
        (V.ι.app t.right).toFunctor.op ⋙ B.obj t)
    (hβ : ∀ t : Under i, (B.obj t).IsLeftKanExtension (β t))
    (hβmap : ∀ (t t' : Under i) (b : t ⟶ t') (X : F.obj t.right),
      Arrow.mk ((β t).app (op X) ≫
        (B.map b).app (op ((V.ι.app t.right).toFunctor.obj X))) =
      Arrow.mk ((θ t t' b).hom.app (op X) ≫
        (β t').app (op ((F.map b.right).toFunctor.obj X))))
 :
    Presheaf.IsSheaf Q.toGrothendieck (colimit B)
